market_summary: Broad risk-off and USD strength dominates across the London/NY overlap. Gold broke down through session lows on a surge in RVOL (>2.0) and negative CVD, offering a clean momentum continuation short. GBPUSD and US100 both confirmed rejections below their Value Area Lows and key S/R levels under downward-sloping VWAP/EMA50 baselines. BTCUSD underwent a high-volume capitulation flush into 72,155 and is currently in mid-channel bounce consolidation, warranting a hold until a structured retest forms.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3950.76) and POC (3978.40) in clear trend expansion. CVD is BEARISH (-7.18) with negative slope (-2.42), confirming strong directional selling pressure. Timing is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price and forming bar remain firmly below VWAP (3965.04) and EMA50 (3957.56). ATR bands are expanding, with price penetrating below the lower ATR band (3921.67). High volume breakdown confirmed with RVOL > 2.0 (2.164 yellow spike on the signal bar). The signal bar cleanly broke below prior S/R at 3924.30 and the previous Session Low at 3904.99, showing clean continuation momentum.
